description: Every running Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad set: Meta's learning status (learning, learned, learning limited), results in the last 7 days against the ~50 a week Meta needs to finish learning, daily budget, and this week vs last week of reach, frequency (how often each person saw the ads) and CTR, with a flag when the audience is tiring. Useful for 'is Meta still learning?', 'why is the cost jumping?', 'are people tired of my ads?'.
